apiContracts: No HTTP route or response changes. The change aligns first-install runtime DDL with the canonical core migration.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: No new migration and no historical SQL edits. Runtime ensureCoreSchema DDL is aligned byte-for-byte at the constraint/default/column level with migrations/0001_initial.sql for the audited core tables.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: The existing 16.64.0 schema-marker fast path is unchanged. This affects fresh and pre-marker bootstrap paths; it does not rebuild existing production tables.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the runtime DDL change if a fresh-install regression is detected. Existing production data is untouched; schema upgrades require a separately reviewed forward migration.

privacySecurity.authorization: The users role CHECK constraint rejects unsupported role values at the database boundary.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Foreign keys enforce owner/reference integrity and explicit deletion semantics for core user-owned records.
privacySecurity.referentialIntegrity: Fresh runtime initialization must match canonical migration foreign keys, including CASCADE for dependent user/novel records and SET NULL for donation user references.

unit: test-runtime-schema-parity.mjs: source-level role, foreign-key and default assertions
integration: test-runtime-schema-parity.py: compare columns, defaults, primary keys and foreign keys for 17 core tables in independent SQLite databases
isolation: invalid role values are rejected by both initialization paths

stagingSteps: Run the dedicated Runtime Schema Parity workflow on the exact integration head.
Verify the full Cloudflare source validation and fresh SQLite migration replay.
Keep production schema preflight read-only; do not rebuild or mutate live tables as part of this feature.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert only the runtime DDL changes and associated tests/workflow if a verified regression appears.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No D1 data or schema mutation is performed by this PR.

collisionReview.migrationAllocation: No migration number allocated; migration 0001 remains immutable.
collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Worker runtime DDL owned by platform-kernel; canonical schema by platform-data; regression tests by platform-quality; workflow by delivery-platform; contract/ADR by platform-architecture.

changeSummary: Aligns the first-install runtime core schema with canonical migration 0001, adding the missing role CHECK and foreign keys while preserving existing runtime fast-path behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Runtime bootstrap and migration 0001 have matching columns, defaults, primary keys and foreign keys for all 17 audited core tables.
Both schema paths reject invalid user roles.
All new tests pass on the exact feature head.
No historical migration is modified and no new migration is allocated.
No production D1 or Worker mutation is performed.
